intended_object: The local coordinate form, in the chart at the identity, of the left-invariant vector field X_v on a Lie group, with the generator v as an extra parameter: (v, y) ↦ X_v(φ⁻¹ y) written in the coordinates of φ. It serves as the right-hand side of an ODE on E × E for the Picard–Lindelöf parameter-dependence argument. Inferred from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation: This is a technical device for proving that the exponential map depends nicely on its parameters. It recasts the invariant integral curves as one autonomous ODE on the model space E × E so that Picard–Lindelöf applies. It is not a standard object with its own definition in the literature. As a helper it is computed correctly. Let g = (extChartAt I 1).symm y. The value `mulInvariantVectorField v g` lives in TangentSpace I g, which Mathlib identifies with E through the chart at g. `tangentCoordChange I g 1 g` then converts it into the coordinates of the chart at 1, at the point g. So the result is X_v(g) written in the identity chart, as the docstring says. The real scalar field ℝ is appropriate here, since the ODE theory and the Lie exponential are over the reals. Mathlib has no matching declaration for this parameterized coordinate field.
